basis: Defined by basal ganglia motor pathway dysfunction; rigidity and tremor do not establish primary muscle damage.
Cardiac malformations; lung hypoplasia 2/2, diaphragm defect 1/2, intestinal malrotation 1/2; cap omits bleeding-time abnormality. Renal enlargement alone is insufficient.
Craniofacial/limb dysplasia and cardiac defects; ptosis 30-79%, pulmonary hypoplasia 1/2. Natal teeth and pigmentation alone do not establish damage.
Viral hemorrhagic fever with thrombocytopenia and bleeding; second-phase neurologic involvement occurs in a minority.
Inherited hepatobiliary transport/metabolic disorder causing intrahepatic cholestasis and progressive liver failure; no common extrahepatic damage established.
Malignancy occupying the orbit; skull-cancer ancestry does not establish bone involvement across this group.
Persistent proptosis classified as a disorder of the orbital eye adnexa.
Congenital abnormal artery-to-vein connection; skin ulceration and other secondary organ damage are not established in at least 30%.
Infectious abscess in tissues surrounding a tooth root; teeth and periodontal tissues fall within gastrointestinal.
Immune-mediated lichenoid inflammation of skin with persistent pigmentation; no common extracutaneous damage established for this variant.
Clonal expansion of hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells; subsequent malignancy and cardiovascular disease are risks, not direct organ involvement.
Peroxisomal metabolic disorder with progressive neurologic degeneration; cataracts in 3/4. Constipation is a symptom; hepatic frequency is unspecified.
Abnormal adrenal or gonadal steroid production/metabolism defines the syndrome; reproductive manifestations have no separate axis.
Congenital underdevelopment of the internal carotid arteries; neurologic infarction is not established as common.
Primary skeletal dysplasia affecting humeri, hips, digits and vertebrae; facial configuration alone does not establish other organ damage.
Self-limited suppression of erythroid marrow production causes anemia and reticulocytopenia; an infectious or immune cause is not established.
Renal tubular salt wasting with defining hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis; hearing loss is limited to particular subtypes.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in the stomach; lymphoma requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Defined by progressive basal ganglia degeneration and erythrocyte acanthocytosis; cardiomyopathy is subtype-dependent rather than common across the umbrella.
Cancer associated with HIV-related immunodeficiency; this umbrella does not specify a shared tumor organ or blood-cell origin.
Defined metabolic acid-base disorder with lactate accumulation; underlying hypoxic organ diseases are separate causes.
Inherited glomerular filtration-barrier disease causing nephrotic syndrome; immune mechanisms and extrarenal abnormalities are not shared across most subtypes.
Hereditary gallbladder disorder; the gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis.
Sarcoma originates in the esophagus; soft-tissue histology does not establish locomotor-system involvement.
Skin-defined immune-mediated reaction to infection or vaccination; associated viral hepatitis is a separate disease, not intrinsic hepatic involvement.
